title: Asghar salaami teer-e-sitam khaaye aathay hain
body:
Asghar salaami teer-e-sitam khaaye aathay hain
Gardhan pidar kay haathoun pa lattkaaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Teeroun ka mehh barastaa hai nanhi si laash par
Kaali ghataa ki tarha laaeen chaaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani diya na zaalimon ney pyaasey margaye
Gul ki tarhaa sey dhoop mein murjhaaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Baazu chidaa hai Shah ka bachcha hai khoon mein tar
Choti si laash chaathi sey liptaaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hazrat ko hai yeh sounch kay Baanu kaheygi kya
Gardhan ko maarey sharm kay nyuddaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Sakina jhaank kay deodi kay pardey sey
Qurbaan hogayi meray maa jaaye aathay hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya zulm hai kay ek kay ser par nahin ridaa
Chehroun pa apney baaloun ko bikhraaye aathay hain
